AI VERIFICATION CHECKLIST

items: Check the source, not just the wording.
Check the date/version for changing information.
Cross-check important claims with primary or authoritative sources.
Read the source document when stakes are high.
Review for missing context and hidden assumptions.
Decide whether a qualified professional should review the result.
